Seneca on 'men of high place,' and the errors we commit in our judgment:

"Why does he seem great to you? It is because you are measuring the pedestal along with the man."

"Consider his soul, its quality and stature, and thus learn whether its greatness is borrowed, or its own." https://t.co/bwUM17rfoz
